## Why This Is Asked

Tests practical diagnostic skill for inter-region network issues, telemetry interpretation, and concrete mitigations.

## Key Concepts

- ECMP hashing behavior
- INT telemetry
- VXLAN EVPN fabric
- Ingress replication
- Backbone rebalancing

## Code Example

```javascript
// example: map flow to ECMP path using a hash
function pathForFlow(srcIP,dstIP,srcPort,dstPort,proto,seed=0){
  const key = [srcIP,dstIP,srcPort,dstPort,proto,seed].join('|');
  return hash32(key) % 8; // 8-path ECMP
}
```
